product_from_film: ChatGPT Deep Research lets users choose sources, adjust a running research task and read or export a sourced report.
explains_well: One consumer-spending question continues through source selection, a follow-up request and a report containing the added retail section.
unclear: The film does not show how a reader checks a particular report claim against its source or resolves a conflicting source.
scenario: Compare US consumer spending and population growth from 2010 to 2020, select sources, add retail analysis and inspect/export the report.
product_clear_basis: The Deep research prompt and source controls visibly define a specific research task by 15s.
